presentation.name: Snowflake semantic view drift
presentation.summary: Finds where a semantic view no longer matches its tables and repairs it without losing hand-written descriptions.
benefits: Classifies drift as added, dropped, renamed or retyped columns, since each needs a different fix
Keeps a renamed column's element name and description instead of replacing them with a new element
Carries existing comments, synonyms and instructions into the regenerated view
Flags new columns that need a description instead of inventing one
